paper_title: Shifting Long-Context LLMs Research from Input to Output
caption: Proportion of real-user demand: The aforementioned 2K range refers to the interval [2K, 4K), and similarly for the other ranges. Solid color fill for input demand, slash fill for output demand in the Wildchat dataset.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates real-user demand counts in the Wildchat dataset for different context-length ranges, showing both input demand (solid fill) and output demand (diagonal slash hatch) for each range. The horizontal axis contains four unlabeled category positions corresponding to 2K, 4K, 8K, and 16K ranges (noted in the caption as intervals [2K,4K), [4K,8K), [8K,16K), and [16K,32K)), arranged from smaller to larger range left to right; within each category, two adjacent bars represent input (left, solid) and output (right, hatched). The vertical axis is labeled “Number” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 120,000 with evenly spaced tick labels every 20,000. For the 2K range, the input bar is a pale yellow solid bar labeled 9,320 and the output bar is pale yellow with diagonal hatching labeled 78,188; for the 4K range, the input bar is a light salmon solid bar labeled 3,784 and the output bar is light salmon with diagonal hatching labeled 108,494; for the 8K range, the input bar is a light blue solid bar labeled 1,401 and the output bar is light blue with diagonal hatching labeled 17,865; for the 16K range, the input bar is a darker blue/gray solid bar labeled 832 and the output bar is the same darker color with diagonal hatching labeled 4,247. Each bar has its value printed above the top, and the legend at the bottom lists the eight series names (2K-Input, 2K-Output, 4K-Input, 4K-Output, 8K-Input, 8K-Output, 16K-Input, 16K-Output) matching the solid-versus-hatched styling and colors; no bars appear additionally emphasized beyond the hatch pattern and numeric annotations.
